note: Record-breaking extension through at least 2035: Emirates is a World Rugby Platinum Partner and Principal Partner of the men's and women's Rugby World Cups; the agreement covers every Rugby World Cup through 2035 (including RWC 2027 and 2029 in Australia and 2031/2033 in the USA), all global qualifying events, and 'Fly Better' branding on all match officials at Rugby World Cups and international fixtures.

source.name: World Rugby: World Rugby and Emirates announce record-breaking partnership extension
